motion_thesis: A question becomes a variable, then the variable becomes visible proof.
core_axiom: Reality is an equation that can be grown, copied, doubled, and proven by scale.
motion_model: question -> variable -> proof -> scale break -> materialized theorem

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-grid-resolve
keyframes.purpose: background grid resolves from scattered points

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-variable-assign
keyframes.purpose: chips/answers snap into labeled variable slots

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-fractal-bloom
keyframes.purpose: token/counter panels scale outward in recursive rings

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-proof-line
keyframes.purpose: thin theorem line draws under headings and CTAs

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-double-pulse
keyframes.purpose: doubling/copy state duplicates along an offset vector

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-scale-break
keyframes.purpose: big-mana or eight-land threshold causes the panel to expand

keyframes.name: vm-quandrix-chalk-drift
keyframes.purpose: subtle chalk particles for inactive theorem notes

placement_card.idle_primary: low-opacity recursive grid shimmer; no constant particles
placement_card.hover: variable chips offset by 2px, cyan edge, green underglow
placement_card.active: double-pulse on the core identity sigil plus proof-line underline

proof_panel.entrance: question copy appears first, then variables, then conclusion
proof_panel.math_chips: assign x/y/z labels; use short stagger; avoid equations users must parse
proof_panel.threshold_state: scale-break animation when land count, counter count, or token count crosses a named threshold

fractal_token_card.hover: recursive outline grows one iteration; do not exceed 2 loops

maze_link.hover: query string appears as clean theorem tags, not raw operator soup

error_state.motion: single variable shake, then snap back to baseline
error_state.copy: That proof does not resolve yet.

accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: disable grid shimmer, chalk drift, recursive loops, and double-pulse; keep instant state changes and static proof-line separators
avoid: hard-to-read mathematical notation as decorative text
repeating symbols that look like captchas
